method.consumer: Eight pnpm-packed packages independently installed with local tarball overrides; no live workspace modules.
method.source: Immutable HTTPS Git source at the corresponding full commit.
method.input: Same archive of the baseline commit plus baseline build outputs for every run.
method.coldHot: Fresh Node process and private source scope for every run; baseline/candidate runs interleaved, then repeated as hot. OS caches are not flushed; not a latency distribution or SLA.
method.counters: Identical --import preload in host and child Node processes: fs/promises, FileHandle stat/readFile, byte counts and root inventory traversals. PID+UUID record names.
method.limits: Counters do not include native Git/tar I/O or the old TypeScript synchronous fs API; do not interpret them as all physical disk I/O.
method.reports: API reports enabled in both variants; CLI diagnostics use --no-reports and isolated HOME/USERPROFILE/APPDATA/XDG_CONFIG_HOME.
method.timers: PGUIDE_TIMINGS=1 for all four comparable API runs; 300000ms preparation, observation and single-check budgets.
method.sourceTiming: Network preparation varies independently of the optimized observation; report both total and observation times.
